description: This file implements a storage system for validation reports using a file-based approach. It provides methods for storing, retrieving, updating, and analyzing validation reports within a directory structure, including cleanup and statistical summarization.

classes.name: ReportStorage
classes.description: File-based storage class for validation reports, extending a base storage class and providing various report management methods.

methods.name: __init__(self, storage_dir: str = "data/reports")
methods.description: Initializes the report storage with a directory, sets up export directory.

methods.name: None _update_index_entry(self, entry: Dict[str, Any], item: ValidationReport)
methods.description: Updates an index entry dictionary with report-specific fields.

methods.name: List[ValidationReport] get_by_request(self, request_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves reports associated with a specific request ID.

methods.name: Optional[ValidationReport] get_by_response(self, response_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a report associated with a specific response ID.

methods.name: List[ValidationReport] search_by_score_range(self, min_score: float, max_score: float)
methods.description: Finds reports whose overall scores are within a specified range.

methods.name: List[ValidationReport] get_failed_validations(self)
methods.description: Returns reports flagged with critical or error issues.

methods.name: Optional[ValidationReport] update_status(self, report_id: UUID, status: ReportStatus, file_path: Optional[str] = None, error_message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and related fields of a report given its ID.

methods.name: Path get_export_path(self, report_id: UUID, format: ReportType)
methods.description: Generates a file path for exporting a report in a specified format.

methods.name: int cleanup_old_exports(self, days: int = 30)
methods.description: Removes export files older than a specified number of days.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_report_stats(self)
methods.description: Provides statistical summaries of stored reports including counts and averages.
